firstPlayerRule: The player at the dealer’s left starts the bidding. The player to the left of the dealer also makes the first lead, whether or not they won the bid.
houseFallback: The rules page does not say how the first dealer is chosen; use the picker.
internalEvidence: Fetched the Winning Moves-hosted rules PDF listed on winning-moves.com/rules/ and extracted its text with pdftotext. PDF page 7: "the bidding begins with the player at dealer’s left and continues clockwise around the table." "First Lead: The player to the left of the dealer (who may or may not be the highest bidder) makes the initial lead and play begins."
uncertainty: How the first dealer is chosen is not stated in the cited section.
